description: Start a Mint 3D model generation lifecycle from prompt and optional image input, creating a new Mint chat unless chat_id is supplied. project_id is required when chat_id is absent; when both are supplied they must match. Provide a prompt, an image, or both. Image-only prompts are supported. Reference images: pass a public direct image URL via image_url; simple public share pages with og:image, twitter:image, or image_src metadata may also work. The server fetches and stashes the image to Mint CDN automatically. Use upload_reference_image only when you have local bytes or want a reusable CDN URL. source_url is source-page metadata only - Mint does not fetch it. Use image_url for reference images. When the user wants a humanoid character suitable for rigging or animation, or explicitly asks for an A-pose or T-pose, set riggable_character; prefer t_pose unless the user explicitly requests an A-pose. mode: "auto" is the default and proceeds straight through to final generation. Set mode: "review" only when the user explicitly asks to inspect, compare, revise, select, or approve a preview before final generation; then use revise_preview or approve_final_generation to continue. Show the returned chatUrl to the user as a clickable link so they can open the generation in Mint. Keep assetId for follow-up tool calls; for code-project imports, follow nextSteps through wait_for_status and get_asset_artifact_manifest. Do not show raw IDs unless the user asks. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked request that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not call it a failed generation.

image_url.description: Public direct image URL. Simple share pages with public image metadata may also work.

riggable_character.description: Set when the user wants a humanoid character suitable for rigging or animation, or explicitly asks for an A-pose or T-pose. Use pose=t_pose by default; use a_pose only when the user explicitly asks for an A-pose.

hands.description: Required for rigging and animation: the character's hands must be empty with no held props.

pose.description: Animation-ready neutral pose. Use t_pose by default for riggable or animatable humanoid characters unless the user explicitly asks for an A-pose.

source_url.description: Source-page metadata only. Mint does not fetch this URL; use image_url for reference images.
